description: This file is a test script for a Perl-based credential helper that interacts with netrc files. It runs multiple test cases to verify behaviors such as handling missing or invalid files, extracting credentials, and decrypting encrypted netrc files. It uses the Test::More framework for assertions and interacts with external scripts and files.

methods.name: run_credential
methods.description: A helper function that runs the credential helper script with specified arguments, passes data to its stdin, and captures the output as a hash of credentials.
